keyword_policy.phrase_rule: Held alternatives only after 24-hour low-volume/auction diagnosis, fresh search-term/overlap review and exact approval; substitute/reroute rather than automatically enabling beside their exact counterparts
keyword_policy.negative_rule: Use actual search terms and existing negative libraries to prove exclusion and avoid blocking valid mother/child demand. Do not upload a guessed watchlist.

campaign_routing.preferred_action: Reuse a suitable verified existing US Search structure after resolving intent ownership and budget isolation
campaign_routing.historical_snapshot_warning: May 20 export shows both US candidates TARGET_SPEND at USD5/day; neither their names nor earlier Manual CPC approval prove current bidding or authority
campaign_routing.italy_rule: Existing Italian Search has a GA4 CPC purchase with conflicting Shopify SEO attribution; investigate that existing campaign when access returns. No duplicate Italy campaign/account recommendation and no Italian allocation in this proposal.
campaign_routing.same_query_owner_rule: Current search terms, exact/phrase positives, negatives, ads and landing routing must have one intentional US/en owner; zero literal duplicate text is not proof of zero semantic overlap
campaign_routing.budget_isolation_rule: An ad group has no separately established campaign budget here. The stage applies only to an approved campaign scope whose entire eligible spend fits this allowance. Do not assume this row set isolates spend from other ad groups or shared budgets; do not pause unrelated entities to force isolation.
campaign_routing.csv_mapping_rule: Campaign cell is an intentional local review placeholder, not a creation instruction. Replace it with the verified selected route, validate every mapped field and effective status, and review parent campaign/ad-group effects before any approved import.

planning_budget.envelope_basis: Temporary conservative interpretation of owner's initial USD50 marketing amount; not a permanent ceiling or authorized recurring daily allocation
planning_budget.basis: For the proposed average-daily-budget route, USD2 x 2 x at most2 account dates = USD8 only under the verified highest-budget-per-date guard below; USD2 remains a planning buffer, not a native lifetime cap.
planning_budget.exposure_gate: Verify current billing rules, currency, account timezone, campaign/shared-budget isolation, budget change history and highest budget on each of the exact two dates; read back effective daily billed limits and an end/stop control under exact authorization. The USD8 arithmetic is unavailable while these facts are unverified. A rolling48-hour window can span3 account dates and is not this proposal.
planning_budget.scope_rule: Count all spend admitted by the approved campaign scope, not merely reported keyword/ad-group spend. Any inability to establish the exposure bound leaves all rows PAUSED.
planning_budget.monitoring_rule: Parent must bind a responsible operator, available review times and action-time authority for exact stop/pause effects. No monitor, scheduled rule or automated stop has been created.
planning_budget.highest_budget_per_date_guard: USD2 must be established before both test account-calendar dates, with no higher average daily budget on either date. Verify budget change history and effective billed limits. A same-date reduction from USD5 to USD2 cannot establish a USD4 limit that date. Keep PAUSED unless a later clean window or recalculated exposure fits an exactly approved stage.

checkpoints.zero_sale_rule: At USD2.50 review actual query intent, landing and purchase coverage. At USD5 reported cumulative spend with zero reconciled paid purchases, pause the exact approved test scope and reconcile reporting lag while paused; do not spend through the uncertainty. This is a risk checkpoint, not a proven product CPA ceiling.
checkpoints.zero_impression_action: Same-day read of effective status/eligibility, policy, destination, keyword low-volume/auction diagnostics, bids, negative conflicts, country/language, schedule and budget. Decide a supported exact/held-phrase substitution within USD0.15 or reject the paid route and continue SEO/free traffic; do not wait passively or raise the CPC cap.
checkpoints.expiry_rule: Hold at end of the second authorized account-calendar date, even after a purchase. No automatic extension or transfer of the remaining USD40.
immediate_stop_conditions: Observed CPC above USD0.15 or an effective bid override
Wrong country/currency/landing or unavailable qualifying variants
checkpoints.statistical_interpretation: A tiny no-sale/no-impression stage is not statistical proof of product failure or channel profitability.

requirements: Current Google Ads purchase conversion action/source and primary/secondary optimization scope; no action or goal changes in this proposal
Existing real-purchase event trace: correct transaction ID, value/currency, no duplicate purchase, and treatment of cancelled/refunded orders
Reconcile attributed Ads/GA4 purchases to paid non-test noncancelled Shopify orders; preserve missing coverage or source conflicts instead of allocating them to paid
Use the same closed acquisition/reporting window and documented currency/timezone conversion; separate attribution lag from no-sale claims
Verify the clicked product/variant and whole acquired basket without treating one line as the whole order
Keep order/customer identifiers and invoice/settlement details in an approved private location; aggregate-only reporting
Do not use synthetic orders, fake events, add-to-cart or tag diagnostics as purchase proof
purchase_verification.known_gap: Recent reconciliation found3 of8 retained paid orders missing from GA4; current Ads spend and exact campaign attribution are unavailable.

economics_and_scale.model_cpa_ceiling_formula: Matching booked merchandise basket value x min(allowable_ad_share, 1/6.5), only when inputs share a consistent revenue base; illustrative until actual costs are verified
actual_costs_required: Settled payment and FX fees in USD
Unrecovered refund/return/replacement expense net of supplier/carrier recoveries
economics_and_scale.double_count_guard: Do not subtract refunded revenue again after using a net-revenue base. Do not add payment fees again to the owner's assumed50% all-other-cost bucket. Foreign-currency fees require settled USD allocation.
economics_and_scale.scale_rule: After multiple independent reconciled paid outcomes and actual US basket contribution, require return-adjusted attributable revenue/ad spend >=6.5 and net profit after all actual costs, ads and supported return loss >=30% of the matching revenue base. Verify CPA fits that contribution. One purchase or cheap CPC does not earn scale.

proposed_repeatability_floor.basis: Conservative review floor, not statistical significance or a forecast
